takeaways.text: Crawl from a priority queue (the frontier),
Detect duplicate content with page signatures,
or the crawler loops and wastes work.
Lower a duplicate's priority instead of crawling it again.
Hand indexing and snippet generation to queues so crawling never waits on them.
